main.description: Enqueue an invoice for ERC-4337 UserOp bundling (ADR 2605011300). N invoices → 1 UserOp via generic.settlement.bundle BPMN. Returns settlementTxHash once the bundled UserOp is mined; before that, returns bundleQueueId. Mokuteki child/future floor is re-checked at bundle time.

payerDid.description: did:erc725 of the payer (smart wallet account, ADR-0074)

quoteSignature.description: Optional signed quote from quotePrice (binds the price within the expiresAt window)

bundleQueueId.description: Identifier for the pending bundle slot. Poll observeDemand or settlement webhook for tx hash.

settlementTxHash.description: Set once the bundled UserOp is mined
